_status: Mike has a line of Island merch coming (Adam, 2026-08-02). Nothing is on sale yet and the payment path is still being decided, so this page announces the line rather than pretending to sell. Deliberately no placeholder products: a fake tee with a fake price on a live site is worse than an honest empty state.
_to_launch: Fill in `items` and set `buy_url` (or per-item `url`). Each item needs at least a name; price, sizes, image and url are optional and render only when present. Once items exist the page switches from the announcement to the product grid on its own — no code change.
headline: Island Fastpitch merch is coming
blurb: A full line of Island Fastpitch gear is on the way for the 2026 Fall season. Tees, hoodies and on-field extras, in league colors.
note: Want to know the moment it drops? Sign up for league alerts and we will include it.
